address: Dr. Lelykade 43, The Hague, 2583 CL, Netherlands
bio: No, you're not in New York City. But, with its ultra-trendy decor, prestigious bottles adorning the wine walls and its large windows flooding the space with natural light, this impressive restaurant on the Scheveningen marina would not look out of place in the Big Apple. And then there is the hip vibe on the luxurious terrace. The Simonis family, renowned fishmongers for generations, showcase their wares here: fish and shellfish take centre stage in traditional dishes, seafood platters, sushi and more. Whether classically pan fried in butter, elevated with umami nuances or incorporated into original creations, the flavours of the sea take pride of place at Catch by Simonis (and there's plenty to please meat lovers, too)....
